about: Short parking permit that a villa owner requests for visitors by SMS.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This service has no sign-in form of its own to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The owner requests it by SMS from a phone number registered in the system; up to 4 numbers can be registered
fees: AED 2 per hour for non-UAE nationals
timing: Requests are sent between 2:00 and 8:00 in the morning
channels: SMS from a registered phone number
